description: This file implements the Time class and related functions for handling date and time operations, including parsing various date formats, converting between time zones, and formatting time outputs. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and references external headers for time manipulation.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class providing various time-related functionalities such as parsing, formatting, and conversions between different time representations and time zones.

methods.name: WeekDayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the weekday for the current Time object.

methods.name: MonthName
methods.description: Returns the name of the month for the current Time object.

methods.name: FromANSI
methods.description: Parses an ANSI string in asctime() format to initialize the Time object.

methods.name: FromRFC1123
methods.description: Parses an RFC 1123 formatted string to initialize the Time object.

methods.name: FromRFC1036
methods.description: Parses an RFC 1036 formatted string to initialize the Time object.

methods.name: FromISO8601
methods.description: Parses an ISO8601 formatted string to initialize the Time object.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns the current system time as a Time object.

methods.name: ToTimeOnly
methods.description: Returns a string representing only the time part of the Time object.

methods.name: ToRFC1123
methods.description: Returns a string formatted according to RFC 1123.

methods.name: ToISO8601
methods.description: Returns a string formatted according to ISO8601 standard.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the Time object into a string based on the provided formatter.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns the internal time representation in microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number of milliseconds to the current Time object.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts a specified number of milliseconds from the current Time object.

methods.name: NTPTime
methods.description: Returns the NTP timestamp representation of the current Time object.

methods.name: DifferenceFromGMTSeconds
methods.description: Returns the difference in seconds between local time and GMT.
